revenueModel.text: Commercial customers and governmental agencies pay for distributed water treatment equipment, laboratory instruments and supplies, plus industrial water treatment engineering projects.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company acts as an exclusive or non-exclusive distributor for well-known manufacturers of such equipment, primarily to commercial customers and governmental agencies in Hong Kong and mainland China, as well as to commercial customers in certain other regions, including Macau.
